overall_notes: This paper introduces ESTER dataset for event semantic reasoning via question answering. The paper evaluates generative QA models using automatic metrics (F1, EM, HIT@1) and human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some normalization of model versions and metric names. No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted.
